title: Scalable s-step Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient with Chebyshev Basis and Gauss-Seidel Gram Solve
summary: We present a variant of the s--step Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) method that combines a Chebyshev--stabilized Krylov basis with a Forward Gauss--Seidel (FGS) iteration for the solution of the reduced Gram systems. In s--step PCG, multiple search directions are generated per outer iteration, reducing global synchronization costs but requiring the solution of small dense Gram systems whose conditioning is critical for stability.
